name: fz520_switcheroo_air_balloon
purpose: Air Balloon given by Switcheroo (issue 520): Klefki, p2a, uses Switcheroo on Arcanine, p1a, and gets its Air Balloon (step 8). target.setItem and source.setItem run the item's Start before the move's -item line (sim/pokemon.ts:1885-1887), and Air Balloon's onStart (data/items.ts:191-195) prints the bare -item line first. A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_1_97), cut after its step 8: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
